import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_joint_equality_isClosed {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  [LinearOrder Y] [OrderTopology Y] {n : ℕ} {f g : Fin n → X → Y}
  (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i)) :
  IsClosed {x | ∀ i, f i x = g i x} := by
  have : {x | ∀ i, f i x = g i x} = ⋂ i, {x | f i x = g i x} := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [this]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_eq (hf i) (hg i)

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_joint_equality_isClosed {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  [LinearOrder Y] [OrderTopology Y] {n : ℕ} {f g : Fin n → X → Y}
  (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i)) :
  IsClosed {x | ∀ i, f i x = g i x} := by
  have hset :
      {x | ∀ i, f i x = g i x} =
        ⋂ i, ({x | f i x ≤ g i x} ∩ {x | g i x ≤ f i x}) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_iInter, mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hx i
      exact ⟨le_of_eq (hx i), le_of_eq (hx i).symm⟩
    · intro hx i
      exact le_antisymm (hx i).1 (hx i).2
  rw [hset]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun i =>
    (isClosed_le (hf i) (hg i)).inter (isClosed_le (hg i) (hf i))

theorem finite_joint_equality_isClosed {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]

  (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i)) :

        {x | f i x ≤ g i x} ∩ {x | g i x ≤ f i x} := by
    ext x

    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨le_of_eq h, le_of_eq h.symm⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_joint_equality_isClosed {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  [LinearOrder Y] [OrderTopology Y] {n : ℕ} {f g : Fin n → X → Y}
  (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i)) :
  IsClosed {x | ∀ i, f i x = g i x} := by
  have hi (i : Fin n) : IsClosed {x : X | f i x = g i x} := by
    have h₁ : IsClosed {x : X | f i x ≤ g i x} :=
      isClosed_le (hf i) (hg i)
    have h₂ : IsClosed {x : X | g i x ≤ f i x} :=
      isClosed_le (hg i) (hf i)
    have heq :
        {x : X | f i x = g i x} =
          {x : X | f i x ≤ g i x} ∩ {x : X | g i x ≤ f i x} := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro h
        change f i x = g i x at h
        change f i x ≤ g i x ∧ g i x ≤ f i x
        exact ⟨le_of_eq h, le_of_eq h.symm⟩
      · intro h
        change f i x ≤ g i x ∧ g i x ≤ f i x at h
        change f i x = g i x
        exact le_antisymm h.1 h.2
    rw [heq]
    exact h₁.inter h₂
  have hclosed : IsClosed (⋂ i : Fin n, {x : X | f i x = g i x}) :=
    isClosed_iInter hi
  have heq :
      {x : X | ∀ i, f i x = g i x} =
        ⋂ i : Fin n, {x : X | f i x = g i x} := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [heq]
  exact hclosed
